resources.string: Off: sending phones sync on this Wi-Fi only
On: sending phones away from this Wi-Fi sync through your Worker
Lets sending phones sync when they\'re away from this phone\'s Wi-Fi. They find this phone through a small service, a Worker, in your own free Cloudflare account.

Phones that can connect directly use no allowance. When they can\'t, Cloudflare\'s relay carries the photos: free up to 1,000 GB a month. Everything is encrypted between the phones; Cloudflare can\'t see it.
Internet sync is on: sending phones can reach this phone now
The address of the MediaSync Worker you deployed
Enter an https address, like https://mediasync.example.workers.dev
Use a Worker you deployed yourself
Set up with your Cloudflare account
1. You need a free Cloudflare account. If you have none, sign up at cloudflare.com.
2. Create a token for MediaSync. Cloudflare opens with what MediaSync needs filled in: editing Workers, and Realtime for the relay. Create the token and copy it.
3. Paste it here. MediaSync uses it once to set up your Worker and doesn\'t keep it.
Starting up. A new address can take a few minutes…
Done: internet sync is on, through your own Worker.
Done, without the relay: the token may not set it up, so phones that can\'t connect directly won\'t sync over the internet. To add it, create a token that may also edit Realtime, and set up again.
Cloudflare doesn\'t accept this token. Copy it again, all of it.
This token may not edit Workers. Create it again with the button, and keep what\'s filled in.
Cloudflare couldn\'t be reached. Check the internet connection and try again.
Your Worker is set up but doesn\'t answer yet. New addresses can take a few minutes; it\'s used as soon as it answers.
Internet sync stops using the relay at %1$s, so it stays free. Starts over on %2$s.
Internet sync stops using the relay at %1$s, so it stays free.
The relay allowance is used up. Sending phones that can\'t connect directly wait until %1$s, or sync over Wi-Fi.
Wi-Fi, Turbo and direct internet connections don\'t count.
Your sending phones sync with this phone at these times while they\'re charging. A phone that isn\'t charging then syncs as soon as it\'s plugged in.
Phones sync as soon as they\'re charging and have new photos. This phone listens while it\'s charging.
Only when you tap Sync now
Nothing runs in the background. Keep MediaSync open on this phone while syncing.
While it\'s charging, this phone gets ready to receive 5 minutes before each time and stays ready until your phones are done.
While MediaSync is open, your phones can sync with this phone at any time.
A sending phone asked for Turbo transfer
Allow MediaSync to connect to nearby devices, so the two phones can link up directly. Then start Turbo on the sending phone again. MediaSync doesn\'t use your location.
Turn on location, so the two phones can link up directly: before Android 13, direct Wi-Fi links need it. Then start Turbo on the sending phone again.
The sending phone is joining a direct Wi-Fi link to this phone. Keep the two phones close together.
For a sending phone away from this Wi-Fi: links the two phones directly. Start here, then Start Turbo there.
On the sending phone, tap Start Turbo. Keep the two phones close together.
